```plato
//==
// # Matrices
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Dense matrix members — the IMatrix, IAdditive and IScalable surface
//  - Sparse and banded matrix readings

library Matrices
{
    //==
    // # Dense matrix members — the IMatrix, IAdditive and IScalable surface
    //
    // The per-type bodies that make the concrete matrices of `matrices.types.plato`
    // genuine `IMatrix` implementations: the shape pair (RowCount, ColumnCount),
    // zero-based element access, and the element-wise IAdditive / IScalable
    // arithmetic. Without these the generated members throw, so the whole derived
    // surface in `numeric-structures.library.plato` (Trace, FrobeniusNorm,
    // Lerp, ...) is unreachable.
    //
    // Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Matrices. Rows are stored as vectors, so
    // element (r, c) is component c of row r, and `Row1` is row index 0. The rows
    // are themselves `IVector`s, so element-wise arithmetic is just the same
    // operation applied per row, and `ElementAt` bottoms out in `IVector.At`.
    //
    // `Add`, `Subtract`, `Multiply(scalar)` and `Divide(scalar)` for `Matrix3x2` and
    // `Matrix4x4` are NOT restated here — those two types carry their full
    // System.Numerics-compatible surface in `matrices-ops.library.plato`, and only
    // the members that file omits appear below.

    //==
    // # Matrix2x2

    // Two rows.
    RowCount(self: Matrix2x2): Integer => 2;

    // Two columns.
    ColumnCount(self: Matrix2x2): Integer => 2;

    // Element (row, column), zero-based; column indexes into the row vector.
    // Precondition: 0 <= row < 2 and 0 <= column < 2.
    ElementAt(self: Matrix2x2, row: Integer, column: Integer): Number
        => row == 0
            ? (column == 0 ? self.Row1.X : self.Row1.Y)
            : (column == 0 ? self.Row2.X : self.Row2.Y);

    // Element-wise sum.
    Add(a: Matrix2x2, b: Matrix2x2): Matrix2x2
        => (a.Row1 + b.Row1, a.Row2 + b.Row2);

    // Element-wise difference.
    Subtract(a: Matrix2x2, b: Matrix2x2): Matrix2x2
        => (a.Row1 - b.Row1, a.Row2 - b.Row2);

    // Every element negated (the additive inverse).
    Negative(self: Matrix2x2): Matrix2x2
        => (-self.Row1, -self.Row2);

    // Composition of two linear maps: applying the result is applying a then b,
    // which under the row-vector convention is each row of a carried through b.
    Multiply(a: Matrix2x2, b: Matrix2x2): Matrix2x2
        => (Number2(a.Row1.X * b.Row1.X + a.Row1.Y * b.Row2.X,
                    a.Row1.X * b.Row1.Y + a.Row1.Y * b.Row2.Y),
            Number2(a.Row2.X * b.Row1.X + a.Row2.Y * b.Row2.X,
                    a.Row2.X * b.Row1.Y + a.Row2.Y * b.Row2.Y));

    // Every element scaled.
    Multiply(self: Matrix2x2, scalar: Number): Matrix2x2
        => (self.Row1 * scalar, self.Row2 * scalar);

    // Every element divided.
    Divide(self: Matrix2x2, scalar: Number): Matrix2x2
        => (self.Row1 / scalar, self.Row2 / scalar);

    // Every element reduced modulo the scalar.
    Modulo(self: Matrix2x2, scalar: Number): Matrix2x2
        => (self.Row1 % scalar, self.Row2 % scalar);

    //==
    // # Matrix3x3

    // Three rows.
    RowCount(self: Matrix3x3): Integer => 3;

    // Three columns.
    ColumnCount(self: Matrix3x3): Integer => 3;

    // Element (row, column), zero-based.
    // Precondition: 0 <= row < 3 and 0 <= column < 3.
    ElementAt(self: Matrix3x3, row: Integer, column: Integer): Number
        => row == 0 ? self.RowElement(self.Row1, column)
         : (row == 1 ? self.RowElement(self.Row2, column)
                     : self.RowElement(self.Row3, column));

    // One component of a three-component row, by column index.
    RowElement(self: Matrix3x3, row: Number3, column: Integer): Number
        => column == 0 ? row.X : (column == 1 ? row.Y : row.Z);

    // Element-wise sum.
    Add(a: Matrix3x3, b: Matrix3x3): Matrix3x3
        => (a.Row1 + b.Row1, a.Row2 + b.Row2, a.Row3 + b.Row3);

    // Element-wise difference.
    Subtract(a: Matrix3x3, b: Matrix3x3): Matrix3x3
        => (a.Row1 - b.Row1, a.Row2 - b.Row2, a.Row3 - b.Row3);

    // Every element negated.
    Negative(self: Matrix3x3): Matrix3x3
        => (-self.Row1, -self.Row2, -self.Row3);

    // Every element scaled.
    Multiply(self: Matrix3x3, scalar: Number): Matrix3x3
        => (self.Row1 * scalar, self.Row2 * scalar, self.Row3 * scalar);

    // Every element divided.
    Divide(self: Matrix3x3, scalar: Number): Matrix3x3
        => (self.Row1 / scalar, self.Row2 / scalar, self.Row3 / scalar);

    // Every element reduced modulo the scalar.
    Modulo(self: Matrix3x3, scalar: Number): Matrix3x3
        => (self.Row1 % scalar, self.Row2 % scalar, self.Row3 % scalar);

    //==
    // # Matrix4x4
    //
    // Add, Subtract, Multiply(scalar) and Divide(scalar) live in
    // `matrices-ops.library.plato`; only the members that file leaves out are here.

    // Four rows.
    RowCount(self: Matrix4x4): Integer => 4;

    // Four columns.
    ColumnCount(self: Matrix4x4): Integer => 4;

    // Element (row, column), zero-based.
    // Precondition: 0 <= row < 4 and 0 <= column < 4.
    ElementAt(self: Matrix4x4, row: Integer, column: Integer): Number
        => row == 0 ? self.RowElement(self.Row1, column)
         : (row == 1 ? self.RowElement(self.Row2, column)
         : (row == 2 ? self.RowElement(self.Row3, column)
                     : self.RowElement(self.Row4, column)));

    // One component of a four-component row, by column index.
    RowElement(self: Matrix4x4, row: Number4, column: Integer): Number
        => column == 0 ? row.X : (column == 1 ? row.Y : (column == 2 ? row.Z : row.W));

    // Every element negated.
    Negative(self: Matrix4x4): Matrix4x4
        => (-self.Row1, -self.Row2, -self.Row3, -self.Row4);

    // Every element reduced modulo the scalar.
    Modulo(self: Matrix4x4, scalar: Number): Matrix4x4
        => (self.Row1 % scalar, self.Row2 % scalar, self.Row3 % scalar, self.Row4 % scalar);
```
